versions.content: If the API Dem_SelectFreezeFrameData is called, the Dem shall use the DTC selected by Dem_SelectDTC and the RecordNumber as a target for the following API calls: • Dem_GetNextFreezeFrameData • Dem_GetSizeOfFreezeFrameSelection
